_new_items.feature: Capabilities page shell: tab row with live per-tab counts, shared search header and refresh hotkey
_new_items.behavior: Open Capabilities → four tabs 'Skills' / 'Tools' / 'Connectors' / 'Plugins', each showing a live count that keeps updating for the tabs you are not on; the header search filters the active tab (search is hidden on Connectors and Plugins, which own their own search) and offers rotating hints built from your own data ('Try …'); the refresh hotkey re-reads skills, toolsets and the official hub index and fails to 'Skills failed to load' with a Retry.

_new_items.feature: Capabilities scope selector (profile / gateway pills above every tab)
_new_items.behavior: Every Capabilities tab carries a scope selector: picking a profile scope pins all reads/writes on that tab (skills, toolsets, connectors, plugins) to that profile, and picking a registered gateway scope routes them to that backend; the selector is hidden for single-profile installs and replaced by a pinned note for plugin-embedded views.

After the main model changes, Model → Main shows a warning '<N> auxiliary tasks (<names>) still run on <other providers>, not your main model.' with 'Reset all to main' and "Don't show again"; dismissing it is remembered per profile so it does not return for the same pairing.

_new_items.feature: Kanban board plugin (boards, cards, assignment to profiles, completion notify)
_new_items.behavior: The bundled kanban plugin adds a board route: boards switchable from a board switcher, tasks as cards that can be created/edited/deleted, moved between columns, commented on, reassigned to a profile ('reassign'), estimated, exported/imported as an archive, and completion notifications posted back to chat.

_new_items.feature: Bots roster / Bot Mode (bots page, avatar picker, per-bot advanced skills)
_new_items.behavior: The bundled hermes-bots plugin registers its own sidebar group, routes and panes: a roster of bots with avatars, create/edit dialogs, per-bot advanced settings (disabled skills, model, groups menu) and group-chat workspaces, plus a profile-group header contribution that opens the bots screen.

_new_items.feature: Install a plugin from Git (repo URL plus Desktop/Agent targets)
_new_items.behavior: The install modal takes a Git repo URL and target halves (Desktop target copies the desktop half onto this machine, Agent target installs into the selected profile); a package copied in by hand with no catalog entry or git remote cannot be agent-installed from here and says so.

hello-runtime is a minimal bundled plugin proving the runtime host bridge (a contributed page that round-trips host requests), and radio is a bundled audio/stream surface; both appear in the installed plugin list as 'bundled' with their own switch.

_new_items.feature: Connectors-page 'Add your own' custom MCP form with paste parsing
_new_items.behavior: 'Add your own' in Connectors opens 'Connect to a custom MCP'; pasting a command snippet fills Name/Type/Command/Args/Env/CWD or URL/Headers/Auth, an unparseable paste says 'Nothing here reads as a server. Fill the fields below instead.', and Save writes exactly one new mcp.json entry after warning about local process commands.

_new_items.feature: Memory Graph overlay (starmap of skills and memories)
_new_items.behavior: Opening the Memory Graph (status bar or /journey) shows an interactive map titled 'Memory Graph' ('<nodes> skills across <clusters> categories') with filters 'All'/'Used', a 'Refresh' action, node context menus, a playback hotkey, and a share box that copies/loads only the layout (never memory or skill text).

_new_items.feature: Open a profile in a new window
_new_items.behavior: A profile's action menu offers 'Open in new window', which opens a second app window already switched to that profile so two profiles can be worked side by side.

_new_items.feature: Name this agent (display name for the default profile)
_new_items.behavior: The profile editor offers 'Name this agent' with a 'Display name' field; the copy layer says 'Sets a display name shown across the app. The internal profile ID stays "default".' and the name is then used wherever the profile is shown.

_new_items.feature: Logs panel in the right sidebar
_new_items.behavior: The right sidebar exposes a 'Logs' panel alongside Terminal/Files/Review; it streams the gateway/backend log tail and is the destination of the various 'Open logs' actions across settings and messaging.

_new_items.feature: 'Add to chat' from a pane (terminal output / preview selection into the composer)
_new_items.behavior: The terminal pane offers 'Add to chat', which puts the selected output into the composer as context instead of the user retyping it; the preview pane has the same affordance for previewed lines.

_new_items.feature: Per-job model override in the cron editor
_new_items.behavior: The cron editor's Model select defaults to 'Default (global model)' and can pin a specific model for that job, so a scheduled job runs on the chosen model regardless of the global setting.

_new_items.feature: Cron job row overflow (edit / run again / delete) and script-only badge
_new_items.behavior: Each job row has 'Edit job', 'Run again' and delete actions plus a 'script' badge for script-only jobs ('Script-only job (no AI prompt). Job id: …'); job rows also show 'Manage' and the runs toggle 'Show runs'/'Hide runs'.
